title: Radio programme: advice for young inventors

sentences.en: … and some people think that only older people – like me – can be inventors.
sentences.zh: ……有些人认为只有年纪大的人——像我这样的——才能成为发明家。

sentences.en: But they’re wrong, you know?
sentences.zh: 但他们错了，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Here’s one example – a young man in South Africa, only 17 years old, saw a problem with water quality and he invented a gel that people can use to wash, to have a bath, even if there is no water.
sentences.zh: 这里有个例子——南非一个只有十七岁的年轻人发现水质问题，就发明了一种凝胶，让人们即使没有水也能清洗、洗澡。

sentences.en: He was only 17!
sentences.zh: 他才十七岁！

sentences.en: So, you guys out there, you shouldn’t wait.
sentences.zh: 所以，你们这些年轻人，不该再等了。

sentences.en: Just go ahead and do it, OK?
sentences.zh: 放手去做吧，好吗？

sentences.en: So now, we don’t have much time, any questions?
sentences.zh: 好了，我们时间不多了，有什么问题吗？

sentences.en: Did the boy in South Africa get rich?
sentences.zh: 那个南非的男孩发财了吗？

sentences.en: I really don’t know.
sentences.zh: 我真的不知道。

sentences.en: I hope so!
sentences.zh: 我希望他发了！

sentences.en: But that’s not the point.
sentences.zh: 但重点不在这里。

sentences.en: He invented something that made other people’s lives better.
sentences.zh: 他发明的东西让别人生活得更好。

sentences.en: He didn’t think: how can I get rich?
sentences.zh: 他没有想：我怎么能发财？

sentences.en: He thought: how can I help people?
sentences.zh: 他想的是：我怎么能帮助别人？

sentences.en: And that’s the place you should start.
sentences.zh: 这才是你们应该开始的地方。

sentences.en: You should start with an idea to help other people.
sentences.zh: 你们应该从一个帮助别人的想法开始。

sentences.en: To make lives easier and, hopefully, better.
sentences.zh: 让生活更轻松，也希望更美好。

sentences.en: I’ve got lots of ideas for inventions.
sentences.zh: 我有很多发明的想法。

sentences.en: Oh? Like what?
sentences.zh: 哦？比如什么？

sentences.en: Well, I don’t want to say.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不想说。

sentences.en: Good for you!
sentences.zh: 好样的！

sentences.en: Be very careful.
sentences.zh: 要非常小心。

sentences.en: You should only talk to people that you trust, OK?
sentences.zh: 你只应该和信任的人谈，好吗？

sentences.en: But another thing: you say you’ve got lots of ideas, and that’s great.
sentences.zh: 不过还有一点：你说你有很多想法，这很棒。

sentences.en: But don’t try to work on all of them at the same time.
sentences.zh: 但不要试图同时做所有想法。

sentences.en: You should say to yourself: which idea is the best one?
sentences.zh: 你应该对自己说：哪个想法最好？

sentences.en: And then you should try to work more on that idea.
sentences.zh: 然后你应该多花心思在那个想法上。

sentences.en: And should I forget the other ones?
sentences.zh: 那我应该忘掉其他的吗？

sentences.en: No, no, no!
sentences.zh: 不不不！

sentences.en: Absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 绝对不要。

sentences.en: I mean, I’m sure you won’t forget them anyway.
sentences.zh: 我是说，反正你肯定也忘不掉。

sentences.en: Yes, another question?
sentences.zh: 好，还有一个问题？

sentences.en: Is being an inventor a job?
sentences.zh: 当发明家是一份工作吗？

sentences.en: I mean, should I leave school and just start inventing things?
sentences.zh: 我是说，我应该离开学校，直接开始发明东西吗？

sentences.en: Hahaha, it sounds like a good idea, right?
sentences.zh: 哈哈哈，听起来是个好主意，对吧？

sentences.en: But to start, when you leave school, I think you should get a job and invent things as a hobby.
sentences.zh: 但一开始，我觉得你毕业后应该先找份工作，把发明当作爱好。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Well, you have to live, don’t you?
sentences.zh: 嗯，你总得生活，对吧？

sentences.en: And maybe your first invention isn’t successful, so where is the money for you to live?
sentences.zh: 而且也许你的第一个发明不成功，那你的生活费从哪来？

sentences.en: No, you should make sure that you’ve got a job and then see if the inventions work out.
sentences.zh: 所以，你应该先确保有份工作，再看看发明能不能成功。

sentences.en: And, look, I’m afraid we’re out of time, we have to stop now.
sentences.zh: 还有，恐怕我们时间到了，现在得停下来了。

sentences.en: I hope the talk was interesting for you all.
sentences.zh: 我希望这次讲座对你们大家都有意思。

sentences.en: Good luck and goodbye!
sentences.zh: 祝你们好运，再见！
